1.w: A Song of the Ascents. O YHWH, Remember for David, all his afflictions,

2.w: how he swore to YHWH [and] vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

3.w: “If I enter into the tent of my house, or if go up on the couch of my bed,

4.w: I will not give sleep to my eyes, [and] slumber to my eyelids,

5.w: until I find a place for YHWH, [a] dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

6.w: Behold, we have heard of it in Ephrathah, we have found it in the fields of Jaar.

7.w: Let us go into His dwelling place; let us worship at the stool of His feet!

8.w: Arise, O YHWH, to Your resting place—You and the ark of Your strength!

9.w: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your holy ones shout for joy!

10.w: For the sake of David Your servant, do not turn away the face of Your anointed one.

11.w: YHWH has sworn [in] truth of David; He will not turn back from it: “I will set one from the fruit of your belly on the throne of yours.

12.w: If your sons will keep My covenant and My testimonies that I teach them, their sons also, forever [and] ever, will sit on the throne of yours.”

13.w: For YHWH has set His choice on Zion; He has desired [it] as a seat for Himself:

14.w: “This [is] My resting place forever [and] ever; here I will sit, for I have desired it.

15.w: I will abundantly bless her provision, [and] her needy ones I will satisfy [with] bread;

16.w: and her priests I will clothe [with] salvation, and her godly ones will shout in joy.

17.w: There I will make to sprout a horn for David; I will arrange a lamp for My anointed one.

18.w: I will clothe his enemies with shame, and upon him his diadem will shine.”
